name: Anchor Mark
description: Save selected text as anchored bookmarks (Ctrl+I) to quickly revisit the exact marked content later.

save_text.description: Very useful for saving text as a bookmark especially for chatting with chatbots. (Ctrl+Shift+S) is the default shortcut.
